tests.description: Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy single-column run (GNU real32 build, dt = 60 s, 59 layers, p_top = 177.6 hPa so NBUF = 44 buffer layers, mp=6 ra_lw=1 ra_sw=1 sf_sfclay=1 sf_surface=1 bl_pbl=1) dumped by the instrumented fork ctessum-claude/WRF@e42a269 (module_esm_dump hooks in RRTMLWRAD and after RTRN inside SUBROUTINE RRTM of phys/module_ra_rrtm.F). RRTM has no standalone real64 driver, so every expected value is the real32 in-model value of MM5ATM/SETCOEF (PAVEL, TAVEL, PZ, TZ, COLDRY, COLH2O, COLCO2, COLN2O, COLCH4, COLO2, CLDFRAC, TAUCLOUD, TBOUND, SEMISS) and the tolerance contract is rel 1e-5. Inputs are the dumped RRTMLWRAD arguments of tile column 1 (p8w, t8w, p3d, t3d, qv..qs, cldfra3d, dz8w, bottom-up) and the scalars co2vmr, n2ovmr, ch4vmr, tsk, emiss. Measured mismatch over the four regimes: pz <= 3e-5 hPa (the real32 Pa -> hPa division), pavel/tavel/tz <= 1.4e-6 relative, coldry and the column amounts <= 7.6e-6 relative (the dominant term is the real32 rounding of the level pressures, 6e-5 hPa on the O(6 hPa) layer thickness), taucloud <= 7e-11, cldfrac exact. Column assertions are Linf_error with abs tolerances of about 1e-5 of each field's column maximum (pz, pavel 1e-2 hPa; tz, tavel 3e-3 K; coldry 6e18 cm^-2; colh2o 2e-4, colco2 3e-5, coln2o 2e-8, colch4 1e-7 cm^-2; taucloud 1e-8; cldfrac, colo2 0); the spot checks at the lowest model layer, the top model layer, the first buffer layer and the top buffer layer use rel 2e-5 for the column amounts (twice the contract, for the real32 level-pressure rounding just described) and rel 1e-5 otherwise. Identities on the inputs (tbound, semiss) use rel 1e-9. Regime: call 1 (19:00 UTC), clear sky, tsk = 288.0 K: taucloud = 0 and cldfrac = 0 everywhere. Ozone (added 2026-09-06, dump scm_ref2_1.json, which the rebuilt fork wrote for the identical SCM run): colo3 is compared with SETCOEF's COLO3 (Linf abs 1e-7 on a column maximum of 6.5e-3, spot checks rel 1e-5 at layers 59-103 where the column is above 1e-3 of its maximum; the lowest layers hold 5e-8 kg/kg with a 6e-4 relative real32 error from the 970 hPa interface pressures) and the climatological mixing ratio o3_clim with WKL(3)/(COLDRY amdo) at the same layers; the NumPy replica of O3DATA on MM5ATM's shifted interval agrees with the dump to 2.5e-6 relative (real32), the unshifted own-layer mean differs by 27 %, which pins the one-layer shift (FORTRAN_BUGS.md B5).

Inputs are the dumped RRTMLWRAD arguments of tile column 1 (p8w, t8w, p3d, t3d, qv..qs, cldfra3d, dz8w, bottom-up) and the scalars co2vmr, n2ovmr, ch4vmr, tsk, emiss. Column assertions are Linf_error with abs tolerances of about 1e-5 of each field's column maximum (pz, pavel 1e-2 hPa; tz, tavel 3e-3 K; coldry 6e18 cm^-2; colh2o 2e-4, colco2 3e-5, coln2o 2e-8, colch4 1e-7 cm^-2; colo3 1e-7; cldfrac and colo2 exactly 0), the spot checks at the lowest model layer, the top model layer, the first buffer layer and the top buffer layer use rel 2e-5 for the column amounts and rel 1e-5 otherwise, and identities on the inputs (tbound, semiss) use rel 1e-9. This regime is one of the four added on 2026-09-06 to cover MM5ATM's cloud block (phys/module_ra_rrtm.F:4252-4255): TAUCLOUD(L) = ABCW CLWP + ABICE CIWP + ABRN PLWP + ABSN PIWP on the model layers and zero on the buffer layers, and the overcast override IF (TAUCLOUD > 0.01) CLDFRC = 1, which replaces the diagnosed cloud fraction of every optically thicker layer by 1 and is the reason RTRN can only ever see 0 < CLDFRAC < 1 in a layer whose cloud optical depth is at or below 0.01. Regime: OVERCAST, optically thick. Call 120, 20:00 UTC (13:34 LST), the deepest cirrus deck of the run (ice only: qc = qr = qs = qg = 0 throughout, qi up to 4.6e-5 kg/kg in layers 51-57). TAUCLOUD = 0.0542, 0.636, 0.760, 0.467, 0.233, 0.0837, 0.0238 there, all above the 0.01 threshold, so the diagnosed CLDFRA 0.0212, 0.561, 0.976, 0.996, 1, 1, 1 is overridden to CLDFRAC = 1 in all seven layers -- the override fires on four of them, including one whose diagnosed fraction is only 2 %. tsk = 285.69 K. Measured mismatch: pz and pavel to Linf 2.9e-5 hPa (the real32 Pa -> hPa division), tz to 2.9e-5 K and tavel to 2.2e-5 K, coldry to 1.1e18 cm^-2 and the column amounts to 3.7e-6 relative (colh2o Linf 3.3e-5, colco2 4.1e-6, coln2o 3.6e-9, colch4 2.0e-8, colo3 2.7e-8 cm^-2), CLDFRAC and COLO2 exactly, and TAUCLOUD to Linf 7.8e-8 on a column maximum of 0.760 (1e-7 relative), so this regime's taucloud tolerance is abs 1e-6 rather than the 1e-8 of the optically thin regimes -- 13x the measured floor and still 1e-6 of the column maximum.

Regime: FRACTIONAL CLOUD. Call 240, 21:00 UTC (14:34 LST), the decaying cirrus deck. Layers 51-54 have TAUCLOUD 0.0728, 0.1423, 0.0709, 0.0403 and are overridden from CLDFRA 0.0542, 0.355, 0.402, 0.388 to CLDFRAC = 1, while layer 55 has TAUCLOUD = 0.009966, just below the threshold, and keeps its diagnosed CLDFRA = 0.1470 -- the largest fractional cloud fraction the scheme admits anywhere in this run, and the input of the RTRNSweep test scm_call240_fractional_cloud. Layers 56-57 are diagnosed overcast already. tsk = 285.85 K. Measured mismatch: pz and pavel to Linf 2.9e-5 hPa, tz to 2.9e-5 K and tavel to 2.0e-5 K, coldry to 9.6e17 cm^-2 and the column amounts to 1.4e-6 relative (colh2o Linf 3.3e-5, colco2 3.7e-6, coln2o 3.1e-9, colch4 1.7e-8, colo3 2.7e-8 cm^-2), CLDFRAC exactly -- including the four overridden layers and the fractional layer 55 that keeps its 0.1470 -- and TAUCLOUD to Linf 6.5e-9 on a column maximum of 0.1423, so taucloud uses abs 1e-7 (15x the measured floor).
